name: Jiang Hao-Chen
source:
The protagonist of "A Light in the Dark". He was kidnapped on his way home and found himself in an unfamiliar, old room with his hands tied. His father is a famous CEO who is constantly abroad on business, making Hao-Chen precocious and independent. He manages to stay calm as a hostage, as he tries to find a way to escape.
